name: Probability Weapon
body:
Aura moderate divination; CL 7th; Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells true strike; Price +1 or +2 bonus.

DESCRIPTION

This weapon betters the probability to hit without increasing accuracy.

+1 bonus: Roll 2d10 instead of a d20 for attack rolls with this weapon.
+2 bonus: Roll 5d4 instead of a d20 for attack rolls with this weapon.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
